title: DepEd addresses COA findings on infra projects, unverified beneficiaries
summary: Department of Education Secretary Sonny Angara on Wednesday addressed the findings of the Commission on Audit over unverified voucher beneficiaries and an infrastructure project in Davao del Norte.
